raw_segments.text: She was really hungry, so the chicken and tart serve to divert her attention for a time.
It was well I secured this forage, or both she, I, and Sophie, to whom I conveyed a share
of our repast, would have run a chance of getting no dinner at all.
Every one downstairs was too much engaged to think of us.
The dessert was not carried out till after nine, and at ten footmen were still running
to and fro with trays and coffee cups.
I allowed Adele to sit up much later than usual, for she declared she could not possibly
go to sleep while the doors kept opening and shutting below, and people bustling about.
Besides, she added, a message might possibly come from Mr. Rochester when she was undressed.
